```{r}
library(ISLR2)
library(rpart)
library(gbm)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
```

```{r}
#Prepare Dataset 
#Define Classification task

data(Carseats)
Carseats$High <- as.factor(ifelse(Carseats$Sales > 8, "Yes", "No"))

Carseat_data <- Carseats[, !(names(Carseats) %in% "Sales")]

table(Carseat_data$High)
prop.table(table(Carseat_data$High))
```

```{r}
#Test-Train split

set.seed(123)
train_index <- sample(1:nrow(Carseat_data), size = 0.7 * nrow(Carseat_data))
train_data <- Carseat_data[train_index, ]
test_data  <- Carseat_data[-train_index, ]
```

```{r}
#DesicionTree
#base Model

set.seed(123)
base_model <- rpart(High ~ ., data = train_data, method = "class")

base_pred_class <- predict(base_model, test_data, type = "class")
base_pred_prob  <- predict(base_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

base_acc <- mean(base_pred_class == test_data$High)
base_auc <- auc(roc(test_data$High, base_pred_prob, levels = c("No", "Yes")))
base_cm  <- confusionMatrix(base_pred_class, test_data$High, positive = "Yes")

print(base_cm)
cat("Base Tree Accuracy:", round(base_acc, 4), "\n")
cat("Base Tree AUC:", round(base_auc, 4), "\n")


```

```{r}
#Bagging

set.seed(123)

bag_model <- randomForest(
  High ~ .,
  data = train_data,
  mtry = ncol(train_data) - 1,
  ntree = 2000,
  importance = TRUE
)

bag_pred_class <- predict(bag_model, test_data, type = "class")
bag_pred_prob  <- predict(bag_model, test_data, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]

bag_acc <- mean(bag_pred_class == test_data$High)
bag_auc <- auc(roc(test_data$High, bag_pred_prob, levels = c("No", "Yes")))

bag_cm <- confusionMatrix(
  bag_pred_class,
  test_data$High,
  positive = "Yes"
)

print(bag_cm)
cat("Number of Trees (Bagging):", bag_model$ntree, "\n")
cat("Bagging Accuracy:", round(bag_acc, 4), "\n")
cat("Bagging AUC:", round(bag_auc, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
#Boosting (gbm نیاز به 0/1 دارد)

train_gbm <- train_data
test_gbm  <- test_data

train_gbm$High <- ifelse(train_gbm$High == "Yes", 1, 0)
test_gbm$High  <- ifelse(test_gbm$High == "Yes", 1, 0)
```

```{r}
#Adaooost

set.seed(123)

ada_model <- gbm(
  High ~ .,
  data = train_gbm,
  distribution = "adaboost",
  n.trees = 2000,
  interaction.depth = 1,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  cv.folds = 5,
  verbose = FALSE
)
best_trees_ada <- gbm.perf(ada_model, method = "cv", plot.it = FALSE)

ada_prob <- predict(ada_model, test_gbm, n.trees = best_trees_ada, type = "response")
ada_pred <- ifelse(ada_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

ada_acc <- mean(ada_pred == test_gbm$High)
ada_auc <- auc(roc(test_gbm$High, ada_prob, levels = c(0, 1)))

ada_cm <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(ifelse(ada_pred == 1, "Yes", "No")),
  factor(ifelse(test_gbm$High == 1, "Yes", "No")),
  positive = "Yes"
)

print(ada_cm)
cat("Best number of trees (AdaBoost):", best_trees_ada, "\n")
cat("AdaBoost Accuracy:", round(ada_acc, 4), "\n")
cat("AdaBoost AUC:", round(ada_auc, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Gradient Boosting 

set.seed(123)

gbm_model <- gbm(
  High ~ .,
  data = train_gbm,
  distribution = "bernoulli",
  n.trees = 2000,
  interaction.depth = 3,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  cv.folds = 5,
  verbose = FALSE
)
best_trees <- gbm.perf(gbm_model, method = "cv", plot.it = FALSE)

gbm_prob <- predict(gbm_model, test_gbm, n.trees = best_trees, type = "response")
gbm_pred <- ifelse(gbm_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

gbm_acc <- mean(gbm_pred == test_gbm$High)
gbm_auc <- auc(roc(test_gbm$High, gbm_prob, levels = c(0, 1)))

gbm_cm <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(ifelse(gbm_pred == 1, "Yes", "No")),
  factor(ifelse(test_gbm$High == 1, "Yes", "No")),
  positive = "Yes"
)

print(gbm_cm)
cat("Best number of trees (Gradient Boosting):", best_trees, "\n")
cat("Gradient Boosting Accuracy:", round(gbm_acc, 4), "\n")
cat("Gradient Boosting AUC:", round(gbm_auc, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Variable importance for Bagging
varImpPlot(bag_model, main = "Variable Importance - Bagging")
importance(bag_model)

# Variable importance for AdaBoost 
ada_imp <- summary(ada_model, n.trees = best_trees_ada, plotit = FALSE)
barplot(ada_imp$rel.inf, names.arg = ada_imp$var, las = 2, cex.names = 0.8,
        col = "#3B6E9E", main = "Variable Importance - AdaBoost",
        ylab = "Relative Influence")

# Variable importance for Gradient Boosting 
gbm_imp <- summary(gbm_model, n.trees = best_trees, plotit = FALSE)
barplot(gbm_imp$rel.inf, names.arg = gbm_imp$var, las = 2, cex.names = 0.8,
        col = "#1B3A5C", main = "Variable Importance - Gradient Boosting",
        ylab = "Relative Influence")
```

```{r}
# final comparison table combining all four models

extract_metrics <- function(cm, acc, auc_val, model_name) {
  data.frame(
    Model       = model_name,
    Accuracy    = round(acc, 4),
    Test_Error  = round(1 - acc, 4),
    AUC         = round(auc_val, 4),
    Sensitivity = round(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"], 4),
    Specificity = round(cm$byClass["Specificity"], 4),
    Kappa       = round(cm$overall["Kappa"], 4),
    row.names   = NULL
  )
}

comparison_table <- rbind(
  extract_metrics(base_cm, base_acc, base_auc, "Base Tree"),
  extract_metrics(bag_cm,  bag_acc,  bag_auc,  "Bagging"),
  extract_metrics(ada_cm,  ada_acc,  ada_auc,  "AdaBoost"),
  extract_metrics(gbm_cm,  gbm_acc,  gbm_auc,  "Gradient Boosting")
)

print(comparison_table)


```

```{r}
# Test error comparison chart 

comparison_table$Model <- factor(comparison_table$Model,
                                  levels = comparison_table$Model[order(comparison_table$Test_Error)])

ggplot(comparison_table, aes(x = Model, y = Test_Error, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Base Tree"          = "#A8C6DF",
    "Bagging"             = "#6FA3C7",
    "AdaBoost"             = "#3B6E9E",
    "Gradient Boosting"   = "#1B3A5C"
  )) +
  labs(title = "Model Comparison (Test Error)", y = "Test Error", x = "Model") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# ROC curve comparison 

roc_base <- roc(test_data$High, base_pred_prob, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
roc_bag  <- roc(test_data$High, bag_pred_prob, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
roc_ada  <- roc(test_gbm$High, ada_prob, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_gbm  <- roc(test_gbm$High, gbm_prob, levels = c(0, 1))

plot(roc_base, col = "black", lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curve Comparison")
lines(roc_bag, col = "darkolivegreen", lwd = 2)
lines(roc_ada, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(roc_gbm, col = "red", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(
         paste0("Base Tree (AUC = ", round(base_auc, 3), ")"),
         paste0("Bagging (AUC = ", round(bag_auc, 3), ")"),
         paste0("AdaBoost (AUC = ", round(ada_auc, 3), ")"),
         paste0("Gradient Boosting (AUC = ", round(gbm_auc, 3), ")")
       ),
       col = c("black","darkolivegreen", "blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
```
